method: Bounded, seeded property testing and parser input mutation

typescript.note: The extra timeout accommodates 10,000 cases per property while the full suite runs concurrently.

rust.note: In-process generated inputs and state transitions. These tests do not perform microphone capture, paid transcription, or NDI transmission.

findings.title: Deeply nested announcements exhaust the call stack
findings.reproduction: Wrap a text node in 12000 bulletList nodes, each with one content child, and pass it inside a doc to sanitizeAnnouncementDocument
findings.expected: Bound input depth and reject or truncate excessive nesting without recursive stack exhaustion
findings.observedBeforeFix: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
findings.fix: Sanitization drops announcement nodes beyond the 64-level depth limit

findings.title: Scripture autocomplete accepts unsafe and infinite chapter numbers
findings.reproduction: Autocomplete John 9999999999999999:16 with a John book entry; also try 309 repeated 9 digits as the chapter
findings.expected: Reject chapter and verse numbers outside the supported integer range
findings.observedBeforeFix: The first chapter rounds to 10000000000000000; the 309-digit chapter becomes Infinity. Both are accepted as complete references
findings.fix: The parser rejects chapter and verse values outside the native Rust i32 range as well as unsafe JavaScript integers

findings.title: Giving network validation accepts inherited object properties
findings.expected: Accept only the four explicitly supported giving networks
findings.observedBeforeFix: The invalid network survives sanitization, and givingPlainText renders [object Object]: 123
findings.fix: Giving network validation uses Object.hasOwn to reject inherited property names

findings.title: Astral Unicode lyric tokens exceed the parser's slide row budget
findings.reproduction: Parse Verse 1 followed by a line containing 137 repeated smiling-face emoji
findings.expected: Preserve authored lyric lines and sections and fit text to the output without reflow
findings.limitation: Notes-to-Preview-to-Live text preservation is verified by the component test; browser visual checks cover the actual shared renderer. Native broadcast transport was not exercised.
findings.observedBeforeFix: The returned block has 274 UTF-16 code units, which the parser estimates as nine rows against its eight-row budget
findings.fix: Automatic parser splitting and lyric canvas wrapping are disabled. The shared lyric renderer scales the font to fit the exact authored lines.
findings.expectedAtDiscovery: Use a consistent length measure when splitting long tokens and estimating row count

findings.title: Negative song result limits behave differently for empty queries
findings.reproduction: Search a four-song index with an empty query and limit -3, then with a nonempty query and the same limit
findings.expected: Apply the nonpositive-limit guard before handling an empty query
findings.impact: Low-level API inconsistency; no UI trigger verified
findings.observedBeforeFix: The empty query returns one song; the nonempty query returns no songs
findings.fix: The nonpositive result-limit guard runs before the empty-query branch

limitations: This is bounded seeded property testing, not proof that every possible input or feature is correct.
Microphone capture, speech recognition accuracy, paid AI or STT calls, physical displays, NDI receivers and network streaming were not exercised end to end.
PDF, PowerPoint and document converter binaries, operating-system file dialogs, updater downloads, and platform-specific behavior outside this macOS machine were not fuzzed.
Native visual checks cover the lyric Notes, Preview and internal Live program canvases. Physical outputs remained off.
The working tree contains existing unrelated changes. Nothing was committed.
status: Expanded fuzz verification passed. Native Notes, Preview and Live preserve the verified authored lyric lines.

followupFindings.title: Safe JavaScript numbers still exceeded the native command integer range
followupFindings.observedBeforeFix: John 2147483648:16 was accepted even though native chapter and verse arguments use Rust i32
followupFindings.fix: Reject chapter and verse numbers greater than 2147483647
followupFindings.evidence: Boundary tests cover chapter and verse overflow, natural-language and compact inputs, exact native maximum values, and normal John 3:16 navigation

followupFindings.title: Long unbroken lyric tokens were clipped by the canvas renderer
followupFindings.observedBeforeFix: The first block of 137 smiling-face emoji was drawn on one line and clipped horizontally
followupFindings.fix: Lyrics preserve complete authored lines and shrink to fit. Oversized-word wrapping is retained only for non-lyric text.
followupFindings.evidence: Canvas tests compare exact authored lines and fitted bounds. The real browser preview confirms six manual lines and a long single emoji line without reflow.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Prepending another verse moved the active selection to the wrong item.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Shift the active index when prepending a new item.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: NaN or infinity durations poisoned timer state and render data.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Ignore non-finite durations and cap finite durations to safe integers.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Restoring six outputs without main inserted a seventh output.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Reserve one of the six slots for the required main output.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Unsafe integer indexes survived storage validation; fractional indexes could skip reassignment.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Require safe stored integer indexes and whole indexes within the connected monitor list.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Non-finite saved timestamps did not survive JSON round trips.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Replace non-finite timestamps with the current time.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Invalid frame dimensions and deltas could produce NaN coordinates.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Validate dimensions, normalize starting positions and discard non-finite deltas.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Negative or invalid aspect ratios produced negative or invalid selection sizes.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Use the whole-frame fallback for invalid aspect ratios.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Translation IDs larger than the safe integer range survived validation.
Non-finite OSC values were accepted as numeric controls or false toggles.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Reject non-finite float and double controls before dispatch.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: Huge search limits overflowed multiplication and could wrap the SQLite limit.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Saturate multiplication and safely convert limits to SQLite integer values.

broadFuzzFindings.problem: A disabled pre-buffer caused removal from an empty vector.
broadFuzzFindings.fix: Skip buffer operations when the configured pre-buffer is zero.

additionalCorrections.change: Preserve authored spaces and hard line breaks with horizontal scrolling for long lines.
Catch and report rejected background saves; add a failure-path regression test.
Use a synchronous interval callback with explicit promise rejection handling.
